name: Zemar
summary: Zemar features an Italian white ceramic top that brings a crisp, contemporary brightness to the piece. The main body and doors are wrapped in light grey matte elm veneer, giving the form a smooth, refined texture with a soft modern character. Inside, melamine panels keep the interior neat and well finished, completing a design that feels polished and elevated. Top with Italy white ceramic, the mainly body and doors cover with elm veneer in light grey matt.inner panels with melamine. 200x42x80
